name: Criterion Weight Perturbation
description: Twenty explicit session-weight settings independently perturb each criterion while keeping other weights equal and preserving original participant and group preference calculations.
purpose: Measure session-ranking sensitivity across a fixed weight grid; adjacent comparisons bound observed winner changes without claiming exact transition thresholds.

scenario.description: Synthetic municipal transportation project selection; no empirical or stakeholder survey claims.
scenario.policy_question: How should a municipal government prioritize transportation improvement initiatives when balancing implementation costs, public accessibility, environmental benefits, and implementation time?

stakeholder_groups.name: Community Residents
stakeholder_groups.description: Residents who use or are affected by the city transportation network.

stakeholder_groups.name: Transportation Department
stakeholder_groups.description: City staff responsible for transportation planning, operations, and infrastructure.

stakeholder_groups.name: City Government
stakeholder_groups.description: Elected officials and municipal leadership responsible for citywide policy and resource decisions.

stakeholder_groups.name: Environmental Advocates
stakeholder_groups.description: Advocates focused on environmental impacts and sustainable transportation.

stakeholder_groups.name: Business Community
stakeholder_groups.description: Local businesses and business organizations affected by transportation access and investment.

cases.name: C1 weight 0.25
cases.description: Apply session ranking weight 0.25 to C1 and split the remaining mass equally among the other three criteria.
cases.purpose: Measure the effect of a specified session criterion weight.
cases.hypothesis: Applied session weights match the specified map; participant and group preference weights remain unchanged. Rank reversals and winner changes are measured, not required.
